title: Brand and Digital
short: Identities, logos, websites, apps, decks and video - designed as one system.
intro: We build brands that hold together everywhere they appear: the mark, the type, the website, the app, the deck and the film.

process.d: Agree what the brand must say, to whom, and against whom.
Mark, type, colour and layout, tested on real applications.
Sites, apps and templates built to be edited by your own team.
Guidelines and source files, organised and ready to use.

title: Marketing and Growth
short: SEO, AI-search visibility, Shopping, paid search, LinkedIn, lead generation and CRM.
intro: We get the right people to find you, and we keep the ones who already did - across search engines, AI answers, shopping feeds and the inbox.

process.d: Where you are found today, and where you are missing.
Technical, content and feed issues, in order of impact.
Content, campaigns and outreach that build on each other.
CRM and follow-up so first buyers come back.

title: Consultancy
short: Go-to-market for energy and battery storage, market entry, expansion and growth strategy.
intro: Practical advice from people who also do the work - especially for energy and battery storage companies entering new markets.

process.d: Your product, your numbers and your constraints.
Markets, buyers, partners and competitors, side by side.
A sequenced plan with owners, budgets and checkpoints.
We stay close while the plan meets reality.

title: Corporate
short: Company decks, datasheets, brand systems, investor and board materials, multilingual sites.
intro: The documents a serious company is judged by - made precise, consistent and easy for your team to keep up to date.

process.d: Facts, figures and existing files, checked at the source.
A clear story and a template system that enforces it.
Every page set to the same standard, in every language.
Editable masters so updates take minutes, not weeks.

title: Investing
short: Own-capital investments in early ventures and long-term equity holdings.
intro: We put our own capital behind early ventures we understand, and hold it for the long term.

process.d: A founder, a problem and a reason it matters now.
We only invest where we can also help with the work.
Simple terms, our own money, no outside funds.
Long-term, patient and close to the founders.
